theme: An open day with a single morning anchor.
greeting: One appointment at nine, Dan, and then the day is yours. The loudest thing on your plate isn't on the calendar at all — it's a cluster of travel bookings gone quietly past due, with the December trip's deadline now two days out.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December-break destination
needsAttention.detail: The decide-and-book deadline on the December trip — all four girls, Dec 13 to Jan 2 — lands in two days. Holiday inventory for six across three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the choice between a domestic shortlist and refundable-only international is the whole decision.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The one p1, overdue since mid-September: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. With the Pathfinder heading south this month, it's the only six-seater for the girls' Maine Christmas, and holiday inventory in that market sells out.

needsAttention.title: Set the Pathfinder drive dates
needsAttention.detail: The Portland-to-St-Pete drive window, Oct 5 to 18, closes this week. The single hotel night can't be booked until the dates are firm.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley: fund your new account
flagged.detail: A final reminder to make the initial deposit on the new Signature Savings account.

flagged.title: Fidium internet bill is ready
flagged.detail: The monthly statement is posted and ready to pay.

flagged.title: Two Disney+ login alerts overnight
flagged.detail: Back-to-back new-login notices around 2 AM — worth a glance if that wasn't you or the kids.

inbox.noise: The rest is reading, not doing: WSJ Economics, the ICGN governance newsletter, your St Pete local, a few LinkedIn invites, and a stack of retail sales.
inbox.clear: Nothing in your primary inbox is waiting on a reply.

resolved.title: Maine ferry tickets confirmed
resolved.detail: The Maine State Ferry reservation came through yesterday and you forwarded it on to Mike — that one's closed.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: An autumn plate built on what the season brings in: chestnuts, winter squash, and game.

tasks.title: Get three term-life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder
Call dermatologist to book Mike's appointment

acts.line: A single appointment with Dr Snowden holds the first hour; the rest of the morning is quiet.
Nothing on the calendar after ten — a genuinely open afternoon to spend on the backlog that's been waiting.
The girls are with Jen this week, so the evening is unhurried.
